value.message: The Kids & Me Drop-In Neighbourhood Group at the Acton library branch runs Thursdays 1 to 2:30, from the second week of Sept, free - Halton Region Public Health says. Links2Care lists free EarlyON centres in Acton and Georgetown for birth to 6, but I could not get into their page today for times. I'll keep watching and text you when I find them.
